shell_commands: git add specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git rm src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorTurnUsage.test.ts && git status

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(orchestrator): remove type-only test that loads no production code

The chatOrchestratorTurnUsage test imported TurnUsage as a type only
(erased at runtime) and asserted arithmetic on a literal, so it could
never fail on a production code change. The re-lint/test-imports-its-subject
rule correctly rejected it. The TurnUsage type shape is enforced by the
TypeScript compiler; the acceptance test already validates the runtime
behaviour through createChatOrchestrator. Remove the stale validation
link from the config-hooks spec accordingly.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1 | tail -5
